item.title: As Winter Olympics end, US looks ahead to Los Angeles 2028 Summer Games
item.description: As the focus turns to Los Angeles, organizers are preparing to host more than 11,000 athletes competing in 36 different sports.

item.title: Texarkana pastor arrested on five counts of rape
item.description: Cedric Monteze Sharp, 51, pastor of Bright Star Missionary Baptist Church in Texarkana, was arrested on five counts of rape and released with court-imposed restrictions.

item.title: High school student in Louisiana praised by President Trump
item.description: What started as a letter about leadership and community service turned into a moment Carson Mallet says he’ll never forget.

item.title: Jack Hughes scores in overtime as US beats Canada for gold at the Olympics
item.description: No miracle needed. The United States is on top of the hockey world for the first time in nearly a half-century.

item.title: Gonzales business owner optimistic about tariff relief impact
item.description: Supreme Court ruling on Trump's tariffs gives hope to small business owner, but uncertainty remains. Rising costs have impacted customers' budgets.

item.title: Man fatally shot by law enforcement at Trump's Mar-a-Lago in Palm Beach
item.description: A man was shot and killed by law enforcement personnel at President Trump's Mar-a-Lago resort in Palm Beach, Fla., early Sunday morning. Secret Service chief of communications Anthony Guglielmi said the man, in early 20s, was killed after "unlawfully entering the secure perimeter" at the resort around 1:30 a.m. local time Sunday. item.title: Thanks but no thanks: Trump’s hospital ship plan provokes defense of Greenland's health care system
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said he would deploy a hospital ship to Greenland, alleging that many people there are sick and not receiving care, even though both of the U.S. Navy’s hospital ships are currently docked at a shipyard in Alabama. item.title: Police identify 1-year-old hit in gas station parking lot; child later dies
item.description: A 1-year-old boy fell out of a pickup truck at a gas station and was run over by the vehicle, resulting in his death.

item.title: Suspect arrested in connection with deadly Ford Street shooting
item.description: Timothy Thomas Jr., 17, was arrested and charged with second-degree murder and illegal use of a weapon in connection to a deadly shooting on Ford Street in Baton Rouge that resulted in the death of 18-year-old Edwyn Williams.

item.title: I-12 closed in St. Tammany Parish due to forest fires
item.description: I-12 is closed in both directions between Highway 59 and Highway 434 in St. Tammany Parish due to active forest fires, and first responders are working the scene while officials urge people not to burn anything.
